name: nori-electron
description: Nori email client — Electron shell + Bun main-process backend (port of crates/nori-desktop + crates/nori-gmail)

scripts.build:main: bun build ./src/main.ts --outfile ./dist/main.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build ./src/preload.ts --outfile ./dist/preload.cjs --target browser --format cjs --external electron
